launches.body:
# \*\*\*\*

**TL;DR:** Contour acquires the  permitting and compliance firms behind America’s critical infrastructure, and runs them on AI, so permitting keeps pace with the buildout instead of holding it back.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UFXX9XADlNk>\
\
America needs to build more, and faster. Big Tech alone is spending $800B+ on AI infrastructure this year. Every data center, power plant and factory behind it needs environmental permits before it can break ground, and that work runs through thousands of small consulting firms already at capacity. We buy these firms and run them on Cortex, our AI operating system. Clients get permitted faster, projects go live sooner, and that speed wins our firms more work.\
\
**The bottleneck nobody is funding**

Capital is flooding into chips, turbines and transformers. But most projects aren’t just held back by engineering. They’re held back by the technical and regulatory work around it: research, studies and applications rebuilt by hand for every project, and constant back-and-forth between developers, consultants and regulators.

Every week of delay is expensive. Data center tenants now ask for $5M+ a day in late-delivery penalties.\
\
**How Cortex works**

Cortex runs agents across each firm’s workflow. They research federal and state rules, run emissions calculations, and draft permit applications and compliance reports. Our people spend their time on judgment and clients, and Cortex gets smarter with every project, across every firm we own.\
\
**Why buy instead of starting from scratch?**

Permitting runs on licensed engineers and decades of trust with regulators and Lenders. No new firm can build that fast, so we buy the ones that have it and run them on one scalable AI platform.\
\
**Where this goes**

We’re starting with environmental consulting, because no project breaks ground without it. From there, we’ll expand into the firms that get infrastructure inspected, certified and kept compliant, and plan to own hundreds of them, all running on Cortex.\
\
